messages:
Harper: Downsizing desk clutter  giving away a vintage floor lamp (works, warm LED retrofit installed), a healthy snake plant (potted, 8in), and 2x standing-room tickets to tomorrow's indie market. Pickup SF office mezzanine by 5pm tomorrow. Photos: https://imgur.com/vintage-lamp :seedling:
Diego: Ooh interested in the lamp! Does it have a foot switch or inline? Any cord fraying?
Harper: Foot switch, cord is fine. Lamp height ~5ft, brass finish (patina but intentional). I replaced the bulb with warm LED so no weird flicker.
Mina: I can take the plant if nobody else wants it. Low-light ok?
Harper: Snake plant is super low-maintenance, been in indirect light only. I'll repot into a paper bag for pickup.
Felix: I could use one of the market tickets if still available. DM me and I'll Venmo a $5 plants-fund donation.
Harper: First to DM gets the tickets. If you only want the plant or lamp, say here and I'll hold until 3pm tomorrow.
Diego: I'll DM for the lamp — can pick up Thu 4pm. If it doesn't fit my apartment, I'll let you know before 5pm.
Mina: Holding for the plant, can pick up Thu 3:30pm. Thanks Harper! :raised_hands:
OfficeBot: :information_source: Reminder: please label items placed in common areas with owner and pickup deadline. Unclaimed items may be relocated to the swap shelf after 72 hours.
Felix: DM'd and sent $5 for plants fund. Thanks Harper! :money_with_wings:
Harper: Tickets spoken for (Felix), lamp tentatively to Diego, plant to Mina. I'll put Post-its on the items: "HARPER - FELIX (TICKET)", "HARPER - DIEGO (LAMP 4PM)", "HARPER - MINA (PLANT 3:30)". If anything changes I'll update here.
Diego: Confirmed pickup Thu 4pm. Appreciate the heads-up on the cord.
Mina: I'll be there 3:30 with a tote. Thanks — excited for a new plant desk buddy :herb:
Harper: Thanks all! If items are unclaimed after 5pm tomorrow I'll move them to the swap shelf or re-post. Cheers :)
